newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot natgas little changed ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot natgas little changed ahead of weekend.

text.p: U.S. spot natural gas prices were on either side of unchanged Friday as cooler weather was forecast to quickly follow a warmer-than-normal weekend across most of the U.S., sources said.

On the Louisiana Gulf Coast, swing prices at the Henry Hub were quoted up about one cent to $2.22-2.25/mmBtu as highs in Houston were expected to hover in the mid-90s F through early next week amid humid conditions.
In the Midwest, where cooler weather was forecast to arrive Sunday, swing prices were talked mostly stable around $2.15.
Chicago city-gate gas was also fairly steady at $2.29-2.32.
In the Permian Basin market, prices were quoted at $2.04-2.10, while San Juan basin gas sold around $2.00.
In the East, New York city gate gas edged a little higher to the low-to-mid $2.40s, traders said.
